title: Brainchomp
description: Extract a rodent brain image and binary mask from mouse or rat MRI.

extract.title: Extract rodent brain
extract.description: Extract a skull-stripped rodent brain image and binary brain mask on the input voxel grid.

image.description: One 3D rodent MRI volume with real voxel sizes.

backend.description: Execution backend (auto selects hardware WebGPU, hardware WebGL2, or threaded CPU).

opening.description: Morphological opening radius in 0.1 mm voxels to detach skull or muscle bridges (0 disables).
